rubrics.justification: Correctly identifies an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona and generally good ICM/TE, but introduces uncertainty about true AA quality from a single image and comments on slight visual-lab mismatch that may not be firmly supportable.
Integrates age, prior IVF failures, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, BMI, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, and partner age well, and explains how these modify prognosis despite good morphology.
Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a plausible prognosis range tied to age and prior failures; minor overinterpretation of image quality slightly weakens the chain.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: single embryo transfer, luteal support, uterine/tubal reassessment, selective PGT-A discussion, and avoidance of unproven add-ons. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative emphasis on image-lab grading discrepancy.

Provides concrete next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support, cavity/hydrosalpinx evaluation, embryo history review, selective PGT-A, and male-factor optimization.
